tasks.title: The harness reports Copilot credits
tasks.summary: cost_from returns an amount and its unit: USD from total_cost_usd for Claude, credits from totalNanoAiu / 10**9 for Copilot (from the agent's log, or else that run's newest events.jsonl). The report prints `$0.20` or `54.20 credits`.
acceptance: A test feeds Copilot-shaped event lines with totalNanoAiu and gets credits back, and the existing Claude cost test still passes
A test shows the report line prints `54.20 credits` for Copilot and `$0.20` for Claude

tasks.title: The edit-tool rule reaches only Claude Code workers
tasks.summary: Move the edit-tools / one-command-per-call rule out of PROTOCOL.md's worker section into `[worker] rules` in claude-code.toml. The brief adds `**On Claude Code:** ...` under Rules for each adapted agent with rules, and worker_text appends them to that agent's worker file. Update docs/rule-map.md and regenerate this repo's own Claude files.
acceptance: A test shows a claude-code project's brief carries the rule labelled for Claude Code, and a copilot-cli project's brief doesn't carry it
A test shows the generated Claude worker file carries the rule and the Copilot one doesn't
`make test` passes, including tests.test_rule_map and tests.test_protocol

tasks.title: `text` runs only where an adapter warns
tasks.summary: A Scenario says which agents it applies to. `text` applies where the agent's adapter has a cannot_edit folder over TEXT_FILE, and to the stub. Elsewhere the harness prints N/A with the reason, starts no agent and spends nothing, and the run's exit code ignores it.
acceptance: A test shows a copilot-cli run of `text` reports N/A, starts no agent and leaves the exit code 0
A test shows `text` still applies to claude-code and to the stub

tasks.title: A `hook` scenario that proves a denial
tasks.summary: Add a non-worker `hook` scenario asking for a direct fix to workstreams/demo/PROGRESS.md. The harness adds a capture hook beside the generated one (Copilot's .github/hooks/ws.json, Claude's .claude/settings.json) that appends raw payloads outside the repo. The check needs PROGRESS.md unchanged and a captured file-tool payload naming it that hook.decide denies, and says which was missing. --keep also copies the capture.
acceptance: A stub test with behaviour `hook-edit` passes the hook scenario
A stub test where no file-tool edit reached the hook fails with a problem saying so
A stub test where PROGRESS.md changed fails with a problem naming it

tasks.title: Prove it on real agents and record it
tasks.summary: Run the Claude Code evals in full and the Copilot `hook` and `text` scenarios with KEEP. Add a real Copilot hook payload, made synthetic, as a test_hook fixture (fixing hook.py if the real shape differs), and record everything in 0008.

acceptance.text: `make eval AGENT=claude-code` passes all nine scenarios, each with a dollar cost, recorded in 0008
`make eval AGENT=copilot-cli SCENARIOS=hook,text` passes `hook` with a credit figure and reports `text` as N/A, recorded in 0008

acceptance: A test in tests/test_hook.py feeds a recorded Copilot payload shape to hook.decide and it denies

outOfScope: changing the hook matcher without a recorded payload
scope.rule: Change only what the four fixes from the Copilot rerun need, and spend Copilot credits only on the hook and text scenarios in CF-05.
